name: code-canopy
description: Build and execute the smallest verified recursive Codex agent tree for an engineering goal.

interface.shortDescription: Build the smallest verified Codex agent tree.
interface.longDescription: CodeCanopy recursively plans bounded specialist and worker nodes, runs only dependency-ready leaves, and keeps Git integration and final verification with one lead.
defaultPrompt: Use $code-canopy to plan this requirement as the smallest verified recursive agent tree.
Use $code-canopy to execute dependency-ready work and integrate evidence bottom-up.
Use $code-canopy to keep this atomic unless delegation adds verified value.
